frame.origin: the centre of the building's leeward face on the ground plane (MP-y_caseH.png, MP-z_caseH.png)
frame.x: +x streamwise (the wind blows toward +x): the building occupies x in [-0.1, 0]; points at x = -0.2 .. 0.4 m
frame.y: +y lateral; the building spans y in [-0.05, 0.05]; the z = 0.0625H plane covers y in [-0.2, 0.2], the others y in [0, 0.2] and the y = 0 line
frame.z: +z up; roof at z = 0.2 m; points at z = 0.01 .. 0.3 m
frame.source: the 4 mm floor hole at (0.05, 0, 0), i.e. 0.25 H behind the leeward face
frame.length_scale: model metres (the source states no model:full scale ratio; Eddy3D solves it at 1:100)

files.format: ASCII STL, LF, metres, same frame as points.csv
files.source: generated from the readme's stated dimensions 0.10 x 0.10 x 0.20 m (width, depth, height); x in [-0.1, 0], y in [-0.05, 0.05], leeward face at x = 0 (MP-y_caseH.png, MP-z_caseH.png). The floor source (4 mm hole at x = 0.05 m, y = 0) is not part of the body
